analysis_type: Exploratory; all nine C labels already known; no blind prediction
comparison: All nine endpoints, fixed START18:52 and 15s data
families: Above fixed bar periods, and same periods multiplied by4 to preserve the prior 1m physical smoothing times. Neither is asserted to be the protected author length. No period search or C-derived length.
features: END price-vs-EMA signs, slopes, three paired cloud positions/order/width, complete eight EMA order and close crossings since START. Compare composite discrete signatures; preserve continuous distances. END shape, close path efficiency/variation and close/volume ranks since START.
seed_check: Repeat proxy initialization with first loaded close +/-100. Reject any claim of stable signature if these scenarios differ; not a bound on actual hidden state.
non_EMA_checks: Collisions in last candle direction, close vs previous, modulo3/9/27 n; shared H/L and rupture confirmed by prior audit.
acceptance: Complete contiguous native history through all ENDs; scoped OHLCV equality to each paired measurement; do not fit thresholds to nine known labels
limits: Disproving tested proxy signatures does not disprove other lengths, multitimeframe EMAs, continuous feature transforms or unobserved state. A unique signature in nine cases is not a formula.
